---
title: "Guide Pool QC"
output: pdf_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(here)
library(knitr)

pool_files <- c(
  pool1 = here("results", "guide_pool_qc", "pool1_bowtie_out.txt"),
  pool2 = here("results", "guide_pool_qc", "pool2_bowtie_out.txt")
)

pretty_pool_name <- function(pool_name) {
  paste("Pool", sub("^pool", "", pool_name))
}

quantile_text <- function(guide_counts) {
  q_values <- quantile(guide_counts$N, probs = c(0.1, 0.9), names = FALSE)
  q_ratio <- if (q_values[1] == 0) Inf else q_values[2] / q_values[1]
  sprintf(
    "Per-pool quantiles: 10th = %.1f; 90th = %.1f; ratio (90/10) = %.2f",
    q_values[1],
    q_values[2],
    q_ratio
  )
}

analyze_pool <- function(pool_name, bowtie_file) {
  if (!file.exists(bowtie_file)) {
    stop(sprintf("Missing Bowtie output for %s: %s", pool_name, bowtie_file))
  }

  # Bowtie1 default output columns:
  # 1 read_id
  # 2 strand
  # 3 ref_id
  # 4 offset
  # 5 seq
  # 6 qual
  # 7 other instances
  # 8 mismatch desc (optional)
  dt <- fread(
    bowtie_file,
    sep = "\t",
    header = FALSE,
    fill = TRUE,
    col.names = c("read_id", "strand", "ref_id", "offset", "seq", "qual", "n_other", "mismatch_desc")
  )

  dt[, mismatch_desc := fifelse(is.na(mismatch_desc) | mismatch_desc == "", NA_character_, mismatch_desc)]

  guide_counts <- dt[, .N, by = ref_id][order(-N)]
  guide_counts[, rank := .I]
  guide_counts[, frac := N / sum(N)]

  dt[, n_mismatch := fifelse(is.na(mismatch_desc), 0L, str_count(mismatch_desc, ",") + 1L)]

  mismatch_pos <- dt[!is.na(mismatch_desc), .(token = unlist(strsplit(mismatch_desc, ","))), by = read_id]
  mismatch_pos[, pos := as.integer(sub(":.*", "", token))]

  q_values <- quantile(guide_counts$N, probs = c(0.1, 0.9), names = FALSE)
  q_ratio <- if (q_values[1] == 0) Inf else q_values[2] / q_values[1]
  q_text <- quantile_text(guide_counts)
  least_covered <- guide_counts[which.min(N)]
  bottom_guides <- guide_counts[rank > 0.9 * max(rank)]

  plots <- list(
    reads_per_guide = ggplot(guide_counts, aes(x = N)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("%s: reads per guide", pretty_pool_name(pool_name)),
        subtitle = q_text,
        x = "Read count per guide",
        y = "Number of guides"
      ) +
      theme_bw(),
    rank_abundance = ggplot(guide_counts, aes(x = rank, y = N)) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_y_log10() +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("%s: guide rank-abundance", pretty_pool_name(pool_name)),
        subtitle = q_text,
        x = "Guide rank",
        y = "Read count (log10)"
      ) +
      theme_bw(),
    mismatch_burden = ggplot(dt, aes(x = factor(n_mismatch))) +
      geom_bar() +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("%s: mismatch count per aligned read", pretty_pool_name(pool_name)),
        subtitle = q_text,
        x = "Number of mismatches",
        y = "Number of reads"
      ) +
      theme_bw(),
    mismatch_position = ggplot(mismatch_pos, aes(x = pos)) +
      geom_bar() +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("%s: mismatch positions", pretty_pool_name(pool_name)),
        subtitle = q_text,
        x = "Position in guide",
        y = "Mismatch count"
      ) +
      theme_bw(),
    bottom_decile = ggplot(bottom_guides, aes(x = N)) +
      geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
      labs(
        title = sprintf("%s: reads per guide (bottom 10%%)", pretty_pool_name(pool_name)),
        subtitle = q_text,
        x = "Read count per guide",
        y = "Number of guides"
      ) +
      theme_bw()
  )

  list(
    pool_name = pool_name,
    bowtie_file = bowtie_file,
    dt = dt,
    guide_counts = guide_counts,
    quantiles = q_values,
    quantile_ratio = q_ratio,
    quantile_summary = q_text,
    least_covered = least_covered,
    plots = plots
  )
}

pool_results <- lapply(names(pool_files), function(pool_name) {
  analyze_pool(pool_name, pool_files[[pool_name]])
})
names(pool_results) <- names(pool_files)

ratio_summary <- rbindlist(lapply(pool_results, function(pool_result) {
  data.table(
    pool = pretty_pool_name(pool_result$pool_name),
    q10 = round(pool_result$quantiles[1], 1),
    q90 = round(pool_result$quantiles[2], 1),
    ratio_90_10 = round(pool_result$quantile_ratio, 2)
  )
}))

guide_count_tables <- lapply(names(pool_results), function(pool_name) {
  pool_counts <- copy(pool_results[[pool_name]]$guide_counts[, .(ref_id, N)])
  setnames(pool_counts, c("ref_id", "N"), c("guide_id", paste0("counts_", pool_name)))
  pool_counts
})

guide_count_summary <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, by = "guide_id", all = TRUE), guide_count_tables)
guide_count_summary[is.na(counts_pool1), counts_pool1 := 0L]
guide_count_summary[is.na(counts_pool2), counts_pool2 := 0L]
setorder(guide_count_summary, guide_id)

guide_count_tsv <- here("results", "guide_pool_qc", "guide_counts.tsv")
fwrite(guide_count_summary, guide_count_tsv, sep = "\t")
```

## Key QC metric: 90th / 10th read-count ratio

```{r ratio-summary}
kable(
  ratio_summary,
  col.names = c("Pool", "10th percentile", "90th percentile", "90% / 10% ratio"),
  caption = "Per-pool guide count spread summary"
)
```

## Guide count table

The per-guide count table is written to `results/guide_pool_qc/guide_counts.tsv`.

```{r guide-count-summary}
kable(
  head(guide_count_summary, 10),
  col.names = c("guide_id", "counts_pool1", "counts_pool2"),
  caption = "Preview of per-guide counts written to guide_counts.tsv"
)
```

```{r pool-report, results='asis', fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
for (pool_name in names(pool_results)) {
  pool_result <- pool_results[[pool_name]]

  cat("\n# ", pretty_pool_name(pool_name), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Input file: `", pool_result$bowtie_file, "`\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Aligned reads: ", nrow(pool_result$dt), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Unique guides hit: ", uniqueN(pool_result$dt$ref_id), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Median reads/guide: ", median(pool_result$guide_counts$N), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Mean reads/guide: ", mean(pool_result$guide_counts$N), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Fraction perfect matches: ", mean(pool_result$dt$n_mismatch == 0), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Fraction 1-mismatch: ", mean(pool_result$dt$n_mismatch == 1), "\n", sep = "")
  cat(
    "- Least covered guide: `",
    pool_result$least_covered$ref_id,
    "` with ",
    pool_result$least_covered$N,
    " reads\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat(
    "- Quantiles (10% / 90%): ",
    sprintf("%.1f / %.1f", pool_result$quantiles[1], pool_result$quantiles[2]),
    "\n",
    sep = ""
  )
  cat(
    "- **Key metric: ratio (90% / 10%) = ",
    sprintf("%.2f", pool_result$quantile_ratio),
    "**\n\n",
    sep = ""
  )

  print(pool_result$plots$reads_per_guide)
  print(pool_result$plots$rank_abundance)
  print(pool_result$plots$mismatch_burden)
  print(pool_result$plots$mismatch_position)
  print(pool_result$plots$bottom_decile)
}
```
